apply_random_geometric_augmentation: create a RandomGeoAug instance and call forward on a BxCxHxW image tensor to apply random geometric augmentations
apply_random_photometric_augmentation: create a RandomPhotoAug instance and call forward on a BxCxHxW image tensor to apply random photometric distortions
generate_perspective_grid: call perspective_grid with transform coefficients and image size to generate a grid of sample locations for perspective warps
draw_truncated_normal_samples: call truncated_normal_ with N samples, mean, and std to draw from a truncated normal distribution
validate_image_tensor_input: call check_input on a tensor to verify it is 4D with 1 or 3 channels, float32 dtype, and values in [0,1]
